correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs. Modulo \(2m\), each residue is the union of two translates of \(H=\langle n,p\rangle\). For \(r\le m\) the second translate is absorbed and the maximum is the Hwang--Song value \(G_0\). Writing \(r=m+s\), symmetry of the two-generated numerical semigroup gives \(G_s=G_0+s(m^2-Q)-2m\lambda_H(sm-Q)\). The elementary lower bound \(\lambda_H(u)\ge u\) excludes every \(s\ge2\). At \(s=1\), the separate cases \(m-Q\in H\) and \(m-Q\notin H\) give a strictly positive correction. The crossed-form argument yields \(\lambda_H(d)=\min(an,bp)\) in the gap case. Independent exact shortest-path Frobenius calculations over a larger small-parameter grid reproduced the universal formula with no mismatch; the finite replay is corroborative, not the proof.
